title: Kähler differentials of a polynomial ring in an arbitrary set of variables
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $T$ any set and $P=R[x_t,\ t\in T]$ the polynomial ring. Then the module of Kähler differentials $\Omega_{P/R}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] is a free $P$-module with basis $(\mathrm dx_t)_{t\in T}$, and for every $g\in P$ one has $\mathrm dg=\sum_{t\in T}\frac{\partial g}{\partial x_t}\,\mathrm dx_t$ (a finite sum), where $\partial/\partial x_t$ is the formal partial derivative of $P$ over $R$. Consequently, for every $P$-algebra $S$, $S\otimes_P\Omega_{P/R}$ is a free $S$-module with basis $(1\otimes\mathrm dx_t)_{t\in T}$.
